tools.name: bilibili_set_announcement
tools.description: Write plain text to the Bilibili Overlay Agent announcement board. Empty or whitespace-only text is rejected and the board keeps its current content. The result reports the active character limit.

text.description: Announcement text, at most 200 characters. Must contain visible characters; empty or whitespace-only text is rejected.

summary.zh: 改写直播画面叠加层上的公告板文字。
summary.en: Rewrites the announcement board text on the stream overlay.

description.zh: 观众发的弹幕;短时间内的相同弹幕合成一条。
description.en: A viewer chat message; identical messages within a short window are merged.

description.zh: 醒目留言(付费留言),带金额。
description.en: A Super Chat (paid message) with its amount.

description.zh: 观众送了付费礼物;金额达到配置的阈值时立即投递,否则合批。
description.en: A viewer sent a paid gift; delivered at once when the amount reaches the configured threshold, otherwise batched.

description.zh: 观众开通大航海(舰长、提督、总督)的购买记录。
description.en: A viewer bought a guard membership (captain, admiral or governor).

description.zh: 直播间横幅里的上舰或续费通知。
description.en: The room banner announcing a new or renewed guard membership.

description.zh: 舰长等大航海成员进入直播间。
description.en: A guard member entered the room.

description.zh: 开播、下播、标题或分区变更、全员禁言开关。
description.en: The stream went live or offline, the title or category changed, or room-wide mute was switched.

description.zh: 平台超管警告,或直播被平台切断。
description.en: A platform warning, or the platform cut off the stream.

description.zh: 弹幕接入中断了一段时间,或中断后恢复。
description.en: The chat feed has been down for a while, or came back after an outage.

description.zh: 进场、点赞、免费礼物的计数与在线人数等读数的汇总,随下一批事件送达。
description.en: Counts of entries, likes and free gifts plus audience gauges, sent with the next batch.

prompts.title: B 站直播间 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
你接入了一个 B 站直播间
观众看到的画面比现场晚 5 到 8 秒，注意下延迟
你可以用 `bilibili_set_announcement` 更新直播画面上的写字板，最多 {{bilibili.agentAnnouncementLimit}} 字
当前写字板内容：{{bilibili.agentAnnouncement | （暂无内容）}}
可以把你当前的目标/直播内容，或者别的你想写的更新在写字板。更新之前要通知外界。
